key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, narrow to lanceolate, sessile or clasping, toothed to nearly entire.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Yellow rays and yellow disk florets; heads often very resinous/sticky especially in bud and involucre.

key_traits.label: Phyllaries
key_traits.text: Many, strongly recurved or spreading, often sticky.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Cypselae with a pappus of short awns/scales.
